a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two operate rounds with no storm, which is about a 4% chance. That would almost certainly kill us both. So I don't think the plan can work, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a better option, say so.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves the reserve empty. I'm sorry. With storms this likely, the plan would almost surely have failed us both. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can try to get your 4.
I'm operating with you from now on, as promised. Once the reserve reaches 4, take it all. I won't take any more.
Still operating. After this round the reserve should be at 4. Take all 4 next round. I won't touch it.
